summary: Applies a DAT-defined convolution kernel to combine neighboring pixels for blur, edge, emboss, sharpen, slope, and 3D convolution effects.

key_params.name: normalize
key_params.note: Normalize coefficients by their sum when possible

common_gotchas: Normalize has no effect when coefficient sum is zero.
Large kernels get expensive because every output pixel samples many neighbors.
Convolve Z requires a correctly arranged cubic 3D kernel table.
Example kernels often assume Normalize is enabled.
key_concepts: Convolve TOP uses a DAT table as convolution coefficients.
The DAT row and column count define the kernel size used around each pixel.
Normalization divides coefficients by their sum when the sum is nonzero.
Apply to Alpha includes alpha in the convolution rather than leaving it alone.
Convolve Z enables 3D texture convolution with a cubic kernel layout.
It is useful for blur, edge detect, emboss, sharpen, and slope-style filters.
